what: dispatch_queue.py validates run.workflow BEFORE it reads status, so a unit that is DELIBERATELY blocked with run.workflow: null reports `invalid -- run.workflow is required`, identically to a malformed job. OBSERVED 2026-09-22 on this branch: RQ-20260922-001/002/006/010 are all status: blocked with a named blocker and all four print `invalid`, while RQ-20260922-003/004/007 (blocked, but carrying a workflow) correctly print `not_due status=blocked`. Two states sharing one value, and the dangerous one is 'this job is malformed' -- a census reading invalid=4 teaches the next reader to skim past it (the alarm-fatigue class this repo grades P1).
